evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/AppRoutes.tsx:37-68 — route groups are composed as flat siblings inside a single <Routes> with NO top-level <ProtectedRoute> wrapper, so each group file is solely responsible for its own auth gating.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/financial.tsx:466-473 — financialRoutes() renders /financial, /financial/invoices, /financial/payments, /financial/budgets, /financial/reports with the page-route components directly and NO <ProtectedRoute> wrapper (the file imports ProtectedRoute 0 times). The wrappers (e.g. FinancialDashboardPageRoute, financial.tsx:66-68) only do `const orgId = user?.organizationId ?? ''` + `enabled: !!orgId`; there is no `<Navigate to="/login">` redirect. So an unauthenticated user who deep-links to a financial route gets the sensitive page shell rendered (empty data) instead of being redirected to login, and ProtectedRoute's setReturnUrl() return-to-page-after-login capture is skipped.

By contrast every other sensitive group wraps each route in <ProtectedRoute> (which redirects unauthenticated users to /login and restores the return URL): buildings.tsx (19 uses), leases.tsx (21), documents.tsx (16), meters.tsx (13), person-months.tsx (9), voting.tsx (7), reports.tsx (5), core.tsx (38). The following groups render with ZERO ProtectedRoute, matching the financial pattern: accounting.tsx (incl. /accounting/invoices, /accounting/payment-matching), ai-dashboards.tsx, disputes.tsx, iot.tsx, messaging.tsx, neighbors.tsx, outages.tsx, announcements.tsx, community.tsx, faults.tsx.

Not a server-side data leak (the API still 401s and queries are gated on orgId), but a confirmed client-side auth-gating inconsistency / defense-in-depth gap on sensitive routes (financial + accounting most notably). Fix: wrap these groups' routes in <ProtectedRoute> for parity with the rest of the app — or hoist a single <ProtectedRoute> layout route in AppRoutes.tsx so gating can't be forgotten per-group.
